description: Hot-swappable reply template families. Common defaults; clients override via configs/clients/<client_id>/reply_template_layer.json. Engine/policy still choose state; this layer only supplies wording. Missing keys fall back to industry reply_templates, add_car one-liner defaults, or handoff_phrases.

missing_doc.already_sent_with_item.zh: 收到。办公室会核对已有材料（含 {item_text}），一般不用重复整套发；若还缺项会明确告诉您。
missing_doc.already_sent_with_item.en: Got it. Our office will verify what is already on file (including the {item_text}). You usually do not need to resend everything—we will only ask if something is still missing.

missing_doc.already_sent_no_item.zh: 收到。办公室会核对您已发的材料，一般不用重复整套发；若还缺项会明确告诉您。
missing_doc.already_sent_no_item.en: Got it. Our office will verify what you already sent. You usually do not need to resend everything—we will only ask if something is still missing.

add_car.collecting.ask_zip.zh: 邮编发我一下，我好往下报价。
add_car.collecting.ask_zip.en: Send the zip and I will run the quote.

add_car.collecting.ask_driver_only.zh: 主要驾驶人发我一下，我好安排报价。
add_car.collecting.ask_driver_only.en: Send me the main driver so I can prepare the quote.

add_car.collecting.ask_delivery_driver.zh: 提车日和主要驾驶人发我一下，我好安排报价。
add_car.collecting.ask_delivery_driver.en: Send the delivery date and main driver so I can prepare the quote.

add_car.collecting.ask_year_and_zip.zh: 年份和邮编发我，我好继续报价。
add_car.collecting.ask_year_and_zip.en: Send the year and zip so I can run the quote.

add_car.collecting.ask_model_and_zip.zh: 车型和邮编发我，我好继续报价。
add_car.collecting.ask_model_and_zip.en: Send the make/model and zip so I can run the quote.

add_car.collecting.ask_vehicle.zh: 可以帮你看这台车报价。年份和车型先发我。
add_car.collecting.ask_vehicle.en: I can quote the new car—send year and make/model first.

add_car.collecting.ask_full.zh: 可以帮你看这台车报价。请发：年份、车型、VIN（有的话）、提车日、邮编、主要驾驶人。
add_car.collecting.ask_full.en: I can quote the new car. Send year, make/model, VIN if you have it, delivery date, zip, and main driver.

handoff.correction_ack.zh: 好的，明白了。办公室会尽快处理，有结果会联系您。
handoff.correction_ack.en: Got it, understood. Our office will review this and follow up with you.
